question: Is Macgregor Mathers the origin of Roswaal’s name, perhaps? I think the origin of Beatrice’s name is Beatrice (note: second Beatrice was written to match the Italian pronunciation), but are there other characters with stories behind their names?
answer: I borrowed Reinhard from The Legend of Galactic Heroes’ Emperor of the Galaxy, outside of that there’s no particular stories behind them. Roswaal, too, was decided on for the sound of it, and it’s not a name that I thought “I’ll do this!’ and brought it in from somewhere. Now that I think back on it, maybe the reason that I thought Mathers sounded like a magic user was I had the idea that Suikoden 2 had a strong magic user of that name? Beako wasn’t from Beatrice, but started from the idea of ‘A girl that it would look right to hold like a teddy bear’, so the ‘Beako’ nickname came first, and I picked the rest later (note: In the Japanese text, bear is pronounced the same as the ‘Bea’ section of Beako). I think that’s about all of it.
